title: GMV Max Guide: Setup, Controls, and Measurement
summary: Understand Product and LIVE GMV Max, account prerequisites, seller controls, automation, creative permissions, attribution, and reporting.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Is GMV Max an ad campaign or an analytics tool?


It is an automated TikTok Shop Ads campaign type with its own controls, delivery logic, reporting, and attribution. The dashboard is part of operating the campaign.


### Does GMV Max guarantee a target ROI?


No. The ROI target guides delivery. Actual spend, gross revenue, margin, and ROI depend on campaign conditions, inputs, inventory, content, demand, and platform delivery.


### Can GMV Max use affiliate videos?


It can use eligible Affiliate Creatives for Ads and other authorized content when the required accounts, product links, permissions, and campaign settings are in place.


### Why does GMV Max revenue differ from Ads Manager or finance data?


GMV Max includes paid and organic orders under its campaign attribution rules. Other reports can use different windows, order states, subsidies, currencies, or revenue definitions.


### Is GMV Max available everywhere?


No. Availability varies by market, account, campaign type, and creation path. Check the GMV Max entry and permissions in your own Seller Center or Ads Manager.
